answer: Up to 20,000 events can arrive twice: offsets are saved every 10 s at 2,000 changes/s, so a crash after publishing but before the offset write replays about 10 s of changes (10 x 2,000). The receiving side should keep, per key (order_id), the highest LSN applied and skip any incoming event whose LSN is at or below it. This makes the apply idempotent and monotonic (a row changes only for a higher LSN).
